{{Short description|Annual mathematics conference hosted by the MAA and the AMS}}
The '''Joint Mathematics Meetings''' ('''JMM''') is a [[mathematics]] [[Academic conference|conference]] hosted annually in early January by the [[American Mathematical Society]] (AMS). Frequently, several other national mathematics organizations also participate. From 1998 to 2020, the JMM was jointly organized and managed by the AMS and the [[Mathematical Association of America]] (MAA).<ref>{{cite web|title=MAA and the Joint Mathematics Meetings|url=https://maa.org/news/maa-and-the-joint-mathematics-meetings|website=Mathematical Association of America|publisher=MAA|accessdate=3 February 2024}}</ref> 

The meeting is the largest gathering of mathematicians in the United States, and the largest annual meeting of mathematicians in the world.<ref>{{cite web|title=Joint Mathematics Meetings|url=https://www.jointmathematicsmeetings.org/|website=Joint Mathematics Meetings|publisher=AMS|accessdate=3 February 2024}}</ref>  For example, more than 6000 people attended the 2017 JMM.<ref>{{cite web|title=Photos from the 2017 Joint Mathematics Meetings|url=https://www.ams.org/meetings/national/jmm2017-highlights|website=American Mathematical Society|publisher=AMS|accessdate=3 February 2024}}</ref>  Several thousand talks, panels, minicourses, and poster sessions are held each year.

The JMM also hosts an ''Employment Center'', which is a focal point for the hiring process of academic [[mathematician]]s, especially for [[liberal arts college]]s. Many employers conduct their preliminary interview process at the meeting.<ref>{{cite web|title=AMS Employment Center|url=https://www.ams.org/profession/employment-services/employment-center/employment-center|accessdate=3 February 2024|publisher=AMS}}</ref>  Often these interviews take place outside the confines of the conference, so the employers may not appear on the official Employment Center listing.
